title: Campaign blob (RAW)
description: data/campaign.json: everything the board, map and query pages read (and the inspector reads a subset of through its own blob). One object per project; designs of all runs live in one array. Field meaning, units, producers and consumers are in docs/data_contract.md section 3. Older blobs without a profile validate once a profile is added.

runs.description: NEW. One entry per run. Required when profile.caps.multi_run is true; a single-run project may omit it (the viewer then builds one virtual run from `run`).

caps.description: LEGACY. Capability flags written by older exporters (min_ipae, complex_rmsd, dg, models, traj, outcomes, glycan, olig, hotspot_rmsd, real). The viewer merges it underneath profile.caps (the profile wins). `real` is deprecated and must not be written by new exports.

generated.description: NEW. Who wrote the file: {tool, version, date}.

target.description: Target block: the reference chain the designs are placed on, plus the context the checks use. All coordinates are in the reference frame. resi/resn/ss/rsa/ca run over the same residues in the same order (the union of the residues of all runs' targets).

resi.description: Residue numbers of the reference chain, UniProt numbering, ascending. Gaps are allowed (a run that deleted a loop, or an unresolved stretch of the reference structure).

resn.description: Residue name per entry of resi. One-letter codes in new exports (older data: three-letter).

ss.description: Secondary structure per entry of resi (H, E or L), from the reference chain.

rsa.description: Relative side-chain accessibility per entry of resi, 0..1, of the reference chain alone. Reserved (not rendered by the current pages).

ca.description: CA coordinates per entry of resi, flat [x,y,z,...], Angstrom, reference frame.

atoms.description: Heavy atoms of the reference chain, no hydrogens. x is flat xyz (3 numbers per atom); res is the 0-based index into resi; sasa is the per-atom solvent accessible area in A^2 of the chain alone (atoms with sasa <= 0.3 are not drawn by the canvas renderer).

hotspots.description: Pooled hotspot residues of all runs (union), UniProt numbering. Per run: hotspots_by_run.

epitope.description: Residues that define the intended epitope (precision and recall are measured against it). Pooled over runs; per run: epitope_by_run.

glycan.description: N-glycosylation sites (Asn) that lie in the reference chain and have an anchor atom in glycan_xyz. Sites outside the construct are listed in profile.frame.glycan_sites only.

glycan_xyz.description: Anchor position (Asn ND2) per glycan site, key = site number as a string.

membrane.description: Membrane-side exclusion plane. A binder atom x is past the plane when (x - centroid) . axis > offset. axis is a unit vector pointing towards the membrane.

source.description: How the plane was derived (UniProt topology, construct end, a chain end of the reference structure ...).

sites.description: Named surface sites. A1 is the intended-epitope site: the page views are oriented by A1.normal. When no run records a hotspot, A1 is built from the residues the designs contact most (or from the whole construct) and its source says so. Other keys (A2, B, ...) are optional.

normal.description: Unit vector from the centroid of the target towards the site (the axis along which the construct is thinnest when the site is the whole construct).

source.description: Present only when the site is not made from hotspots: where it comes from (no hotspots recorded, the residues the designs contact most or the whole construct).

construct.description: [first, last] residue of the union construct.

dom.description: Domain or segment label per entry of resi. Reserved (not rendered by the current pages).

foot.description: Named residue footprints of known complexes (for example the binders of a known complex), name -> residues.

olig.description: Partner-subunit (oligomer) context. buried: reference-chain residues buried by the partner(s) in the assembly, residue (string) -> buried area in A^2. neigh: partner CA traces, chain key -> flat xyz (the inspector blob carries the copy the pages draw).

chains.description: NEW. Chain keys of the partners, in drawing order.

labels.description: NEW. Chain key -> label shown on hover.

source.description: NEW. Where the partners come from, e.g. '1ABC assembly 1'.

min_area.description: NEW. Smallest buried area (A^2) that counts as buried (default 5).

orig_resi.description: NEW. For each entry of resi, the residue number in the structure BindCraft was given (construct numbering, shown on hover), or null.

numbering.description: NEW. How UniProt numbers relate to the input numbering: orig = uniprot + input_offset.

reference.description: NEW. Where the reference coordinates come from.

given.description: false when no full-length reference structure was given: pdb is then empty and the construct is the frame.

unresolved.description: NEW. Ranges inside the construct span that are missing from the reference structure. Drawn as a chain break (a gap in the CA trace), not as a removed region.

hotspots_by_run.description: NEW. run id -> hotspots of that run, UniProt numbering.

epitope_by_run.description: NEW. run id -> epitope residues of that run (restricted to residues present in the run's target).

glycan_atoms.description: NEW. Heavy atoms of the sugars attached to glycan sites, key = site number as a string. Used for the glycan distance and for drawing.

resn.description: Sugar residue names in order, e.g. [NAG, NAG].

rest.description: NEW. Rest-of-chain context: the parts of the full-length chain that no run's target contains (the union of removed regions is per run, see runs[].target.removed).

ranges.description: Ranges outside the union construct, UniProt numbering.

run.description: Project-level run summary. Legacy single-run blobs carry the BindCraft counts here (n_traj, n_traj_pass, n_scored, n_accepted, cols, failure); dataset blobs carry dataset counts (n_total, n_boltz, n_sample, n_binders_*, license, credit). For a multi-run project this block summarises the whole project and the per-run numbers live in runs[].

source.description: Origin of the designs, e.g. 'BindCraft v1.5', 'a public dataset'.

n_traj.description: Trajectories attempted. null = unknown (the Trajectory folders were not given).

failure.description: [[filter stem or column, label, count], ...], most frequent first. A sequence can fail several filters, so the counts overlap.

run_item.description: NEW. One run. Settings, target construct, funnel and filters are per run because two runs of one target can differ in everything (hotspots, lengths, construct, filters).

source.description: Tool and revision text shown in the UI, e.g. 'BindCraft v1.5'.

folder.description: Basename of the run folder (no absolute path is written anywhere in the bundle).

families.description: Backbone families with at least one accepted design.

settings.description: Run settings. Hotspots are given twice: in UniProt numbering (hotspots) and as written in the settings (hotspots_input).

hotspots_input.description: Numbering of the file BindCraft was given (construct numbering).

sources.description: Where each value came from: settings_json, csv, inferred or unknown, keyed by setting name.

metric.description: Key in design.m that carries the same quantity (null when the page has none).

provenance.description: counter-verified, bounded or memory: a reconstruction of BindCraft 1's default threshold, and how well the data support it (binder_review.config). campaign: the threshold the run recorded itself (BindCraft 2, campaign_metadata.json), which also carries source, mandatory, judged_per_model and value_stem.

source.description: campaign rules only: where the threshold was read (campaign_metadata, or settings.min_plddt_final).

mandatory.description: campaign rules only: BindCraft fails a design whose metric could not be measured.

judged_per_model.description: campaign rules only: BindCraft judges the filter on each validation model while the CSV holds the rounded mean.

value_stem.description: campaign rules only: the key of design.src.average that holds the values (the campaign's own name is repeated there).

filters.description: The filter set that decided accepted or rejected, as far as it is known: the thresholds the run recorded itself (BindCraft 2) or, for a run that records none, BindCraft 1's reconstructed defaults. Builds the BindCraft filters group of the query page.

filter_set.description: Only for a run judged by the thresholds it recorded itself (BindCraft 2): source (campaign), n_rules, unevaluated (recorded thresholds on metrics Binderscope does not carry or that no design carries: name, op, threshold, mandatory, source, reason), unlimited (names recorded with an infinite threshold: no limit, no rule) and a note. A run on BindCraft 1's reconstructed defaults has no filter_set.

funnel.description: Ordered funnel stages. An unknown count is written as n null with status unknown and is drawn as '?', never as 0.

failure.description: Same shape as run.failure, for this run.

traj_basis.description: What design.traj counts: attempted trajectories, or only the trajectories that passed (the row order of trajectory_stats.csv), or nothing (traj is 0).

epoch.description: Settings epoch. Estimates must never be pooled across different epochs.

paratope.description: NEW. Paratope of the accepted designs of a scaffolded run. Absent for a run that is not scaffolded or whose edit spec cannot be used (the reason is in the run's notes).

paratope_rejected.description: NEW. The same block over the rejected designs; the contrast with the accepted block shows what the filters removed.

run_target.description: NEW. The target construct of one run, in UniProt numbering. The residues present are the union of resi_ranges; removed lists the stretches deleted from the construct (their flanks are extra cut points); unresolved is not repeated here (it belongs to the reference structure).

resi_ranges.description: Contiguous stretches of residues present, ascending, e.g. [[40,87],[96,129],[142,210]].

removed.description: Stretches missing between first and last, e.g. [[88,95],[130,141]].

cut_points.description: Residues next to a cut: the first and last residue when the construct is cut there, and the residues flanking every removed stretch.

input_offset.description: orig = uniprot + input_offset for this run's input file.

consistent.description: Every structure of the run carries the identical residue set.

modes.description: Binding modes (clusters of contact position), keys M1..M7 ordered by size. The CSS defines seven colours and shapes, so at most seven modes exist; the modes module merges the smallest clusters into M7 when it finds more.

name.description: Short label, shown on the legend and map (up to about 40 characters).

note.description: One to three sentences shown in the mode detail panel. Absent in older blobs (profile.modes.notes holds the text).

n.description: NEW. Accepted designs in the mode.

n_rejected.description: NEW. Rejected designs assigned to the mode.

enr.description: Residues enriched in this mode against all others.

site.description: NEW. Key of target.sites that this mode overlaps most.

auto_name.description: NEW. True when the name was generated from the residues instead of written by hand.

fold.description: TM-align fold similarity between the binders. tm is a base64 string of an n x n uint8 matrix (row-major), TM-score x 100 normalised by the shorter chain, symmetric, diagonal 100. ids gives the design id of each row in order.

diversity.description: NEW. Reference results of the family statistics at the default thresholds, per run (never pooled) and pooled (descriptive only). The viewer recomputes interactively; both must agree at the defaults (tests compare them).

distance_default.description: Average-linkage cut distance (1 - similarity) per basis.

fold_weight.description: Weight of fold distance in the 'both' basis (0.5).

estimates_valid.description: False for the pooled block when the runs have different epochs: no coverage or forecast is given.

clusters.description: basis -> list of clusters, largest first.

counts.description: basis -> {n, S, f1, f2}: families, clusters, clusters seen once, clusters seen twice.

advice.description: basis -> Chao-Jost readout (see data_contract.md section 3.9). Present only when estimates_valid and design order is known.

snew.description: Expected new clusters after m = 1..n more families, m up to n.

replay.description: Backtest: what the readout would have said after each checkpoint of the run, and what the run went on to find.

fold.description: NEW. Present, with status off, for a run built on a fixed scaffold: the fold-based bases (fold, both) are then left out of clusters, counts, sweep, advice and replay_by_basis.

basis_off.description: NEW. Bases left out of this block because they include fold distance.

basis_default.description: NEW. Only when it differs from the project's basis_default: the basis this run is read on.

design.description: One designed binder sequence with its complex model, placed in the reference frame of the target. Accepted and rejected designs share this shape; status tells them apart.

id.description: Unique across the project. The BindCraft design id when that is unique, otherwise '<run>/<design id>'. Used for tiles, links (#d=<id>), decisions.

name.description: The design id as the tool wrote it (without _model suffix). Differs from id only when ids had to be made unique.

run.description: NEW. Run id (runs[].id). A single-run legacy blob may omit it.

rank.description: NEW. BindCraft rank within the run (accepted designs).

bb.description: Backbone id: one BindCraft trajectory. The unit of a family.

fam.description: Family id. Equal to bb in every data set so far.

s.description: Sequence index on the backbone (the mpnn number); 1 when the source has none.

traj.description: Generation order of the backbone within its run (1 = first), in units of runs[].traj_basis. 0 = unknown or not applicable.

sc.description: Fold class: scaffold name (synthetic data), design class (datasets), or fold-cluster label F1, F2, ... from the families module (BindCraft runs).

site.description: Key of target.sites nearest to the design's contact centroid. Not rendered by the current pages.

flip.description: Mock flag: the re-score placed a confident design elsewhere. false when there is no re-score.

ca.description: CA of the binder, one point per residue (3 * len numbers), reference frame.

rf.description: Pose of the re-scored model relative to the design: [R (9), t (3)]. Identity when there is no re-score.

view.description: Canonical thumbnail view: rows are the view x, y and z axes in the reference frame.

tc.description: Target residues in contact (any heavy-atom pair within 4.5 A), UniProt numbering, ascending.

bc.description: Binder residues in contact, 0-based indexes into seq/ca (the board draws ca[3 * i]).

hot.description: Contacted residues that are hotspots of the design's own run.

hot_of.description: NEW. Number of hotspots of the design's own run (the denominator of 'hot'). Falls back to target.hotspots.length.

glycan.description: Distance in A from the nearest binder heavy atom to each glycan site of target.glycan (sugar atoms when modelled, else the Asn ND2 anchor). Key = site number as a string.

models.description: Predictor entries. BindCraft-only data: one entry {model: 'AF2 (BindCraft)', ipsae: null, iptm: i_pTM, rmsd: Hotspot_RMSD}.

b.description: Disulfide entries only (Unpaired cysteine, Disulfide geometry loose): whether the pairing came from the structure file's record or was inferred from the model's SG-SG distances because the file records none.

inspect.description: Tag of this design in the inspector blob, or null.

pl.description: Per-residue pLDDT, 0..100 (B-factor of chain B for BindCraft). Optional: when absent the pages disable pLDDT colouring (they must not invent values).

wt.description: Sampling weight (inverse sampling probability) when the set is a sample; 1 otherwise. Used with outcomes.

fpov.description: Contacted residues inside each footprint of target.foot, name -> count.

model.description: k of the _model{k} suffix: the AF2 model whose pose is in the structure file.

model_file.description: Structure file relative to the run folder (accepted/<name>_model<k>.pdb).

csv.description: CSV the scores were read from.

notes.description: BindCraft's Notes column (e.g. 'Relaxed structure contains clashes.').

marked.description: Row highlighted in the run's xlsx (meaning unconfirmed).

fit.description: How the design was placed on the reference chain: interface (the superposition is weighted around the binder), all (every shared residue counts the same) or core (the residues a trimmed fit keeps). It differs from the mode asked for (manifest.thresholds.placement) when there was nothing to weight around (fit_note says why).

fit_note.description: Why the design was not placed by the fit that was asked for; absent otherwise.

src.description: NEW. Scores exactly as the tool reported them (CSV scales), so that recomputed values in m can be compared. average: stem -> Average_<stem>; models: model number -> {stem: value}; interface_aas: amino-acid counts at the interface.

fail.description: NEW. Filters the design fails under the run's filter set (empty for accepted designs). One entry per rule and scope.

nm.description: NEW. Near-miss summary of a rejected design.

worst_rel.description: Largest relative miss over the failures.

score.description: 0..1, higher = closer to passing (1 - worst_rel clipped, penalised by n_failed).

near.description: True when the design is a near-miss: it fails one stem, and by no more than 25 % of the threshold. Never true when a failure is not measured.

unmeasured.description: Only for a run judged by the thresholds it recorded itself: the stems BindCraft reported as failed whose size the CSV does not show. A design with any is not near and has score 0.

outcome.description: Assay outcome of a design (plumbing for the lab data pass). Kinetic constants in SI units. Hidden behind the reveal switch; the whole object is absent when profile.caps.outcomes is false.

binds.description: Binding detected. null = tested, not conclusive.

strength.description: Strong, Medium or Weak, as the source labels it.

sample.description: Sample name in the lab files (maps to the design).

source.description: File the result was read from.

metrics.description: Page metrics of one design. Every core key is present; a quantity the data does not carry is null (the viewer then switches the checks that need it off). Scales: 0..1 unless a unit is given. docs/data_contract.md section 3.6 lists meaning, units, producers and consumers.

plddt.description: Mean pLDDT of the binder in the primary complex model.

iptm.description: i_pTM of the primary model (BindCraft: Average_i_pTM; datasets: Boltz-2 ipTM).

iptm_b.description: BindCraft's own i_pTM (Average_i_pTM). Equal to iptm when BindCraft's AF2 is the primary model.

ipae_norm.description: BindCraft Average_i_pAE: inter-chain PAE divided by 31 (0.35 = 10.85 A).

ipae_mean.description: Mean inter-chain PAE in A (ipae_norm * 31 for BindCraft, or from a PAE matrix).

min_ipae.description: Lowest inter-chain PAE in A, from a PAE matrix. Null for BindCraft-only data.

ipsae.description: ipSAE (the minimum over the two chain orders) of a co-folding model. Null for BindCraft-only data.

ipsae_max.description: ipSAE, maximum over the two chain orders (datasets).

complex_rmsd.description: CA RMSD in A of the binder in the re-score model against the design pose after aligning on the target. Null without a re-score.

binder_rmsd.description: BindCraft Binder_RMSD (binder alone against binder in the complex); datasets: ESMFold monomer against the complex shape.

hotspot_rmsd.description: BindCraft Hotspot_RMSD: movement of the binder between trajectory and prediction after superposing the target.

target_rmsd.description: BindCraft Target_RMSD, or the placement RMSD of the design's target on the reference when BindCraft gives none.

dsasa.description: Surface area buried on binding, recomputed from the structure (BindCraft's own dSASA is in src).

dg.description: Rosetta interface energy in REU (BindCraft dG, more negative is better). Null without PyRosetta output.

n_hbonds.description: Interface hydrogen bonds, donor-acceptor heavy-atom pairs within 3.5 A, recomputed.

n_salt.description: Interface salt bridges within 4.0 A, recomputed.

n_unsat.description: Buried polar atoms without a hydrogen-bond partner within 3.5 A, recomputed.

hyd_frac.description: Share of the interface area that is carbon or sulfur.

hphob_patch.description: Largest exposed hydrophobic patch on the binder.

loop_frac.description: Share of the binder's interface residues that are in loops.

helix_frac.description: Share of binder residues in helices.

iface_helix.description: Share of interface residues in helices.

epi_prec.description: Share of the contacted target residues that lie in the intended epitope of the design's run. null when the run records no hotspot.

epi_rec.description: Share of the intended epitope (restricted to the run's target) that is contacted. null when the run records no hotspot.

mem_excess.description: Largest signed distance of any binder heavy atom beyond the membrane exclusion plane; negative = clear by that much, positive = crosses it.

nterm_d.description: Distance from the binder's first CA to the nearest target heavy atom.

cterm_d.description: Distance from the binder's last CA to the nearest target heavy atom.

seed_spread.description: Spread of the pose over repeat seeds.

n_agree.description: Independent predictors that reproduce the design (0..3).

ciplddt.description: Interface pLDDT, 0..1 (BindCraft i_pLDDT; dataset complex ipLDDT).

pde.description: Predicted distance error of a dataset entry.

lis.description: Local interaction score of a dataset entry.

olig_min.description: Smallest distance from any binder heavy atom to any heavy atom of the partner subunit(s) (glycans included). Null without partner context.

olig_n3.description: Binder heavy atoms within 3.0 A of the partner subunit(s).

olig_n4.description: NEW in m (inspector octx had it). Binder heavy atoms within 4.0 A of the partner subunit(s).

olig_n.description: Contacted target residues that are buried at the partner interface in the assembly.

stalk_n.description: Contacted residues in the flagged region of the profile (for example a stalk). Absent for targets without a flagged region.

rest_min.description: NEW. A. Smallest distance from any binder heavy atom to the removed regions of the same chain (everything the design's target lacks, glycans included).

rest_n3.description: NEW. Binder heavy atoms within 3.0 A of the removed regions.

rest_n4.description: NEW. Binder heavy atoms within 4.0 A of the removed regions.

cut_n.description: NEW. Contacted target residues within checks.cut_k residues of a cut point (construct ends and the flanks of removed stretches of the design's run).

cov_n.description: NEW. Contacted target residues that the removed regions would bury (SASA drop above checks.cover_min_area).

place_rmsd.description: NEW. A. CA RMSD of the design's target chain on the reference chain over all shared residues, under the transform that placed the design (prov.fit).

place_iface_rmsd.description: NEW. A. CA RMSD of the design's target chain on the reference chain over the residues near the binder (within about 13 A of a binder heavy atom, in the design's own frame): how well the placement fits where the context checks depend on it. null when no residue is that near.

place_iface_n.description: NEW. Number of residues behind place_iface_rmsd.

place_global_rmsd.description: NEW. A. CA RMSD over all shared residues that the plain whole-target fit gives (the smallest any rigid transform reaches); place_rmsd minus this is what the interface fit gives up over the parts of the target far from the binder.

diversity_axis.description: NEW. One diversity axis of a scaffolded run. Every axis carries a status; an axis that is unknown or off carries a `why` a person can read, because a silently missing number reads as a bug.

status.description: observed: counted from the data. unknown: could not be determined, `why` says why (never drawn as zero). off: deliberately not given for this run, `why` says why.

epitope_diversity.description: NEW. Epitope spread of a run: how far apart the families' epitopes are. Computed for every run (diversity.runs[].epitope), scaffolded or not, because it does not depend on fold or modality. The epitope of a family is every target residue contacted by any of its accepted designs.

status.description: observed: counted from the data. unknown: could not be determined, `why` says why (never drawn as zero). off: deliberately not given for this run, `why` says why.

n_families.description: Families that have an epitope (at least two for the status to be observed).

pairwise_jaccard.description: [lowest, highest] Jaccard overlap between two families' epitopes, two decimals.

shared_by_all.description: Target residues every family contacts (UniProt numbering when `numbering` says so).

sizes.description: Family id -> number of target residues in its epitope.

source.description: Where the residues come from: BindCraft's Interface_Target_Residues or contacts recomputed from the structures. Never mixed within a run.

paratope_block.description: NEW. Which segments of the scaffold touch the target, over the accepted (runs[].paratope) or the rejected (runs[].paratope_rejected) designs of a run built on a fixed scaffold. Absent for a run that is not scaffolded or whose edit spec cannot be used. Regions come from the campaign's edit spec (settings.filters.Scaffold_Sequence_Retained_Fraction.params.scaffold_edits), not from IMGT numbering; the contact criterion is BindCraft's Interface_Binder_Residues.

scaffold.description: File name of the scaffold (no directory).

naming.description: How the segments were named; generic means numbered, with no CDR language.

name.description: CDR1..3 (VHH), H1..3 / L1..3 (scFv, Fab) or 'designed segment n'. CDR language only for antibody modalities.

scaffold.description: First and last designed position of the segment in the scaffold's numbering (the campaign's own edit spec, not IMGT or Kabat).

designed.description: Designed stretches inside the segment, [first, last].

length.description: [lowest, highest] length of the stretch the spec lets vary, else the span of the segment.

variable.description: [first, last, lo, hi] of each stretch whose designed length varies.

framework_designed.description: Designed positions outside every segment (a VHH's framework-2 face).

aligned.description: Designs of the whole run placed on the scaffold.

unaligned.description: Designs of the whole run that could not be placed; they are reported, never guessed at.

n.description: Designs of this group that went into the block.

share.description: Region -> percent of the group's interface residues, one decimal, regions with none left out.

framework_share.description: Percent of interface residues outside every designed segment.

loop_use.description: Which designed segments a design touches: designs per set of segments (an empty set is a design that binds through framework alone).

n.description: Designs with an interface residue there.

diversity_paratope.description: NEW. runs[].diversity_paratope: what varies in a run built on a fixed scaffold, where fold diversity is switched off because every design shares the scaffold. Four axes, each observed, unknown or off; none is invented.

profiles.description: Distinct sets of designed segments touching the target among accepted designs.

values.description: Length of the variable stretch, one per family, ascending.

classes.description: Length classes: a class is a chain of lengths each within class_gap residues of the next.

design_para.description: NEW. designs[].para: where one design's interface residues fall on the scaffold. Absent when the run is not scaffolded or the design did not align.

segments.description: Region (designed segments and framework regions) -> interface residues, regions with none left out.

loops.description: Designed segments with at least one interface residue, in scaffold order.

framework.description: Interface residues outside every designed segment.

lengths.description: Segment -> length of its variable stretch in this design.

face.description: VHH only: designed framework-2 face positions (scaffold numbering) -> the residue in this design.

face_mutated.description: The face positions whose residue differs from the scaffold's.

framework_at.description: [region, scaffold position] of each framework interface residue, for naming a framework contact by position.

term_grade.description: NEW. One tag size at one end: whether a tag of that size can be carried by the end, and the linker it needs.

s.description: free: fits against the end as it is. linker: fits once l residues of linker carry it out of the way. blocked: no room within the longest linker tried (15 residues), or, for a folded fusion only, the end itself is in the interface. For an unstructured tag (His6, Twin-Strep) the test is whether a flexible chain of its length can route from the end into open solvent without crossing the target or the binder; for a folded fusion (GFP, Fc) it is a sphere in a cone.

l.description: Linker residues needed (0 when free). null when blocked.

why.description: Only when blocked. contact: the terminal residue touches the target (folded fusions only). room: no way out to open solvent (flexible tags), or nothing in the cone of directions the chain can leave in is clear (folded fusions).

esc.description: Flexible tags only. A. Length of the shortest path from the end to open solvent (the tag's clearance from every atom), through space at least 3 A from every atom, as found on a 2.5 A grid. null when there is none within the longest linker. Compare it with the tag's reach (runs[].term.tags[].budget).

term_end.description: NEW. One end (N or C) of one design, judged against the predicted complex. Numbers are rounded for display; an end the structure cannot judge has conf off, a reason in why and null in the rest.

d.description: A. Terminal CA to the nearest target heavy atom of the design's own construct (the nterm_d or cterm_d of design.m).

d_env.description: A. Terminal CA to the nearest atom outside the construct (the other subunit, the rest of the protein, a glycan) as the placed pose shows it. null when that was not checked.

env_what.description: Which of those d_env is measured to.

at.description: The binder residue (1-based) the probe starts from: the terminal residue, or the last ordered residue when the end is a disordered tail.

dir.description: Unit vector, in the frame of inspect.designs[].pdb_b: the direction the chain leaves the fold in at the end.

aim.description: Degrees between dir and the direction from the probe origin to the nearest target atom: 0 points at it, 180 points away.

away.description: Cosine of the angle between the end's offset from the binder's centre and the binder's offset from the interface centre: 1 is the side of the binder farthest from the paratope, -1 the paratope side.

side.description: paratope: within 10 A of the target, in the interface, or on the interface side of the binder (away below -0.25). far: away at least 0.25 and not near. lateral: otherwise.

contact.description: The terminal residue is in the 4.5 A interface.

iface_n.description: How many of the three terminal residues are in the interface.

rsa.description: Mean relative solvent accessibility of the three terminal residues in the complex (the interface buries some).

plddt.description: Mean pLDDT of the five terminal residues.

ss.description: Secondary structure of the terminal element: the first helix or strand reached from the end. null when the chain is loop throughout.

tail.description: Loop residues between the end and that element.

room.description: A. Radius of the largest sphere that fits against the end without a linker (capped at const.room_cap). 0 when none does. The judgement behind g.

limit.description: What stops the first tag size that is not free: the target, the binder's own fold, the other subunit, the rest of the protein or a glycan.

conf.description: ok. low: the terminal residues are below pLDDT 70 or the end is a disordered tail, so where it lies is a guess. off: not judged.

via_tail.description: The end is a disordered tail judged from its last ordered residue, with the tail counted as linker.

why.description: Only when conf is off: the reason.

design_term.description: NEW. designs[].term and inspect.designs[].term: which end of the binder can carry a tag or a fusion and what it costs (docs/termini.md). Present for accepted designs and near-miss rescues only. A prediction from one predicted conformation. When applies is false the question has no answer for the molecule (a cyclic peptide has no free ends) and nothing else is present.

format.description: de novo, VHH, scFv, Fab, ARP, cyclic peptide or the raw modality word.

copies.description: Protomers of a homo-oligomer binder; a tag appears on every copy.

nc_d.description: A. Between the first and the last CA (BindCraft's termini_together measure).

env.description: The other subunits and the rest of the protein were part of the check (a reference structure was given). false: they were not, and the absence of a finding there says nothing.

pick.description: Tag size key -> the end to tag. Room first, then the side of the binder (an end on the paratope side loses to one that is not), then the linker needed. both: alike. none: neither can carry it.

immob.description: The end to hold the binder by (SPR, BLI, a plate) so that the paratope faces away from the surface: of the ends that take a short tag, those on the far side from the interface. null when there is none.

run_term.description: NEW. runs[].term: what molecule the run designed, whether BindCraft was asked to keep its ends free, the tag sizes and the constants the designs' term blocks were judged with.

known.description: The run recorded its modality. false: read as de novo because nothing said otherwise.

convention.description: The end the format's usual practice tags (C for a VHH). Not used to judge a design; the pages set the result beside it.

known.description: The run recorded its settings. false: nothing is claimed either way.

accessible.description: BindCraft was asked to angle both ends away from the target (termini_accessible).

together.description: BindCraft was asked to bring the two ends within 10 A (termini_together).

buried.description: BindCraft was asked to bury the ends (protease_stable), the opposite of what a tag wants.

tags.description: The tags judged: key (his6, strep, domain, large), what it stands for, how it is tested (kind) and a size. A flexible tag (His6, Twin-Strep) is an unstructured peptide: r is the clearance in A that counts as open solvent for it, res its length in residues, motif how many of them must lie in open solvent, budget the reach in A (3.3 A per residue) it has beyond the motif. A globular tag (GFP, Fc) is a sphere of radius r.

env.description: A reference structure was given, so the designs were checked against what lies outside the construct.
